title: Finding a job in the AI era
summary_en: As artificial intelligence reshapes job applications, WashU career expert Casey Jenkerson advises job seekers to use authentic language, build networks early and focus on essential skills. She also warns against dishonest AI tactics and emphasizes the importance of human connection in hiring.
title_cn: Finding a job in the AI era

title: Pregnancy nutrition trial in Ecuador improves fetal brain growth
summary_en: WashU researcher Lora Iannotti and colleagues tested whether a diverse diet inspired by ancestral eating patterns could support maternal nutrition and fetal development.
title_cn: Pregnancy nutrition trial in Ecuador improves fetal brain growth

title: American parents need comprehensive work-family plan
summary_en: A reported proposal by Vice President JD Vance redirecting childcare subsidies to married couples with a stay-at-home parent will not address fundamental challenges in the market, including soaring costs and limited availability, according to WashU sociologist Caitlyn Collins.
title_cn: American parents need comprehensive work-family plan
